project_description: Complete proxy-supported prompt-cache locality optimization by synthesizing stable downstream conversation-affinity hints when clients omit them, projecting those hints through explicit provider/model capabilities to documented provider wire fields, preserving explicit client cache/affinity intent, and keeping session affinity, prompt-cache hints, and backend-observed cache residency as separate authorities. This is a brownfield completion spec over the implemented routing affinity, secure-session, prompt-cache-key, residency/control, connector ABI, provider-profile, and observability foundations. The implementation defined here is intended to fully close generic proxy-side cache hinting with no planned follow-up work.
